item.description:
SleekDemo 2.2.0

Smarter zooms that pan with you, a voice that sounds clean, camera layouts and a lot of polish.

  • Smart zoom — zooms on what you do, glides with your pointer and steps out for page changes and pauses.
  • Camera layouts — webcam bubble, full-screen camera, side by side or screen only, animated.
  • Enhance Voice — background noise and room echo removed on your Mac.
  • Better captions, area recording and animated backgrounds.
  • Fixed: exports stalling, Cancel and Quit during export; smoother preview.

SleekDemo 2.1.0

A sharp, smooth pointer you can restyle after recording, a rebuilt zoom camera, clip editing and a new look.

  • A pointer that looks great — redrawn razor-sharp at any zoom; resize, smooth, click rings, bounce, click sounds and idle hiding.
  • Smoother zooms that chain into pans, follow your pointer and keep it clear of your webcam.
  • Smarter auto zoom from clicks, drags, typing and menus.
  • Clip editing — split (⌘B), cut, trim and change speed.
  • Pixelate and spotlight overlays, keystrokes on screen, and export up to 4K at 30 or 60 fps.
  • A calmer, Apple-style editor and a new app icon.

SleekDemo 2.0.0

The first release of SleekDemo for Mac.

  • Recorder — screen or window, system audio, microphone and camera, with a live camera preview.
  • Smooth camera motion — spring-based zooms with motion blur and a jitter-free follow camera.
  • Auto zooms from your clicks, camera cutouts that shrink while zoomed, and on-device captions.
  • Export to MP4 or GIF, and automatic updates.
